Stone Giant Elder Sorcerer 6
CR 12

XP 19,200
Female stone giant elder sorcerer 6
N Large Humanoid (Giant)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +25

DEFENSE

AC 29, touch 14, flat-footed 26 (+4 armor, +2 deflection, +2 Dex, +1 dodge, +11 natural, -1 size)
hp 171 (12d8+6d6+6 favored class+90)
Fort +15, Ref +10, Will +13
Defensive Abilities Rock Catching; Resist acid 10

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee +1 short spear +19/+14/+9 (1d8+8)
Ranged rock +14 (2d8+10)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks Rock Throwing (180 ft.)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +19)
1/day–stone shape, stone tell, and either transmute rock to mud or transmute mud to rock (DC 20)
Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 6th; concentration +15, ranged touch +13)

3rd (4/day)— fly

2nd (6/day)— blink, invisibility, scorching ray

1st (8/day, 7 remaining)— charm person (DC 16), identify, mage armor, obscuring mist, shocking grasp

0th (at will)—dancing lights, daze (DC 15), flare (DC 15), ghost sound (DC15), light, mending, prestidigitation
Tactics Daily, Conna casts mage armor on herself. This spell is reflected in her statistics.

Str 25, Dex 15, Con 21, Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 21
Base Atk +12; CMB +20; CMD 32
Feats Alertness (as long as Gutfinder is in arm’s reach), Arcane Strike, Combat Casting, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Eschew Materials B, Extend Spell, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Mobility
Skills Acrobatics +16, Climb +24, Fly +16, Knowledge (Arcana) +8, Perception +25, Spellcraft +10, Stealth +11 (+19 in rocky terrain); Racial Modifiers +8 Stealth in rocky terrain
Languages Common, Giant, Draconic
SQ arcane bond (bat familiar named Gutfinder), Metamagic Adept (1/day)
Combat Gear potion of barkskin +4; Other Gear +1 short spear, ring of minor acid resistance, ring of protection +2, headband of Charisma +2

SPECIAL ABILITIES
Arcane Bond (Su)

Gutfinder the Bat, N Diminutive Animal: Init: +2, Senses: blindsense 20 ft., low-light vision, Perception +25;

DEFENSE: AC 19, 16 touch, 17 flat (+2 Dex, +4 size, +3 natural); hp 85 (6d8); Fort +0, Ref +4, Will +7, Improved Evasion;

OFFENSE: move 5 ft, fly 40 ft (good); bite +17 (1d3-4); space 1 ft; reach 0 ft.;
